pin.description: A budget hotel and hostel hybrid near Copenhagen Central Station, with private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and lively common spaces.

pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hotel and hostel hybrid near Copenhagen Central Station, with private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and lively common spaces.

Family and budget stay

Choose a whole private family room and confirm beds, occupancy and any cot needs. An individual bed in a shared dormitory is a different booking product. The communal guest kitchen can help families prepare food; access is subject to house rules and available equipment.

The Colbjørnsensgade property is near Copenhagen Central Station and Tivoli. Compare the full private-room charge, breakfast, taxes and other extras for your dates. The bar and social spaces suit travellers comfortable with a lively hotel atmosphere.

Review tradeoffs

Guest feedback supports the useful kitchen and central location, while other recent guests report tired rooms and weekend street noise. Read recent reviews and request a suitable room if quiet sleep matters. Tripadvisor component scores are a research snapshot, not live ratings.

Portfolio entry and current name

Urban House Copenhagen had operated since 2015 when it officially joined the MEININGER portfolio on 1 January 2017. The opening-era operator release listed 218 rooms. This dated pin marks that portfolio entry.

A December 2025 operator release renamed the same property MEININGER Hotel Copenhagen and reported 235 rooms and 873 beds. That later inventory is distinct from the 2017 count. No property-specific construction or conversion investment was verified.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-22: Tripadvisor UK snapshot 4,634 reviews; Rooms 4.0, Service 4.0, Location 4.6, Cleanliness 4.3, Value 4.1, rounded to nearest half step. Sarah M firsthand family review displayed August 2026 without exact publication day, date null. Recent wear/noise tradeoffs retained. MICHELIN complete Copenhagen list 1–20 of 20 has no MEININGER or Urban House; Forbes Copenhagen directory likewise has no match. AAA geographic awards program does not cover Denmark. Acclaim 0 means no distinction verified in those checked directories.

pin.longFormSummary:
A LEGO-themed family hotel beside the LEGOLAND Florida park entrance, with themed bedrooms, a separate children’s sleeping area, treasure hunts and a hotel pool.

Family stay

Choose the exact room theme and bed layout for your party. Current room themes and refurbishments differ from the original launch inventory. The hotel advertises interactive play, in-room treasure hunts and a pool; verify scheduled activities and pool operating conditions for your stay.

The resort also sells room-only stays, so park admission is not included in every booking. Check your chosen package for tickets, breakfast, occupancy, fees and cancellation terms. The hotel is distinct from Pirate Island Hotel and Beach Retreat.

Review tradeoffs

Guests praise the immersive theming and walk to the park. Recent family reviews also describe dated rooms, restaurant service delays and expensive food. The Tripadvisor Value component is 3.6/5 in the opened snapshot; compare the complete holiday cost rather than assuming a budget stay.

Opening and scale

LEGOLAND Florida Resort announced the hotel’s opening on 15 May 2015, with 152 rooms and suites. Its original release describes separate adult and children’s sleeping areas. This is the hotel opening, not the 2011 park opening. No hotel-specific development investment was verified; the historical 2015 room promotion is not used as a current rate.
